summary: Private (VPC): request timeouts due to mis-sized NLB idle timeout
description:
Issue summary:
- MedAxis Private VPC deployment: long responses intermittently timing out at ~350s.

Impact:
- Customer sees connection closed / timeout on longer prompts.
- Failures occur more often when output is large (multi-minute generation).

Primary symptom: Request timeouts
Deployment offering: Private

Notes:
- Customer NLB idle timeout is set to 350s; our streaming responses can exceed this with slow consumers.
- Need to confirm recommended NLB/ALB timeouts and keepalives for Private deployments.
comments: Camila Reyes (2026-03-25): Escalating; customer is in UAT and blocked on reliability sign-off.
Soojin Lee (2026-03-26): Reproduced by throttling client read; NLB closes connection after idle timeout even though stream is active.
Soojin Lee (2026-03-26): Workaround: increase idle timeout to 900s + enable TCP keepalive; shared config snippet with customer.
Camila Reyes (2026-03-27): Customer confirmed no further timeouts in soak test.
